item.title: Security Alert: U.S. Embassy Warsaw (November 18, 2026)
item.content:encoded:
Security Alert: U.S. Embassy Warsaw (November 18, 2026)

Location: Warsaw, Zielonka, Marki, Kobyłka, Wołomin and Legionowo

 

Event: The Polish Ministry of National Defense reports that the Military Institute of Armament Technology in Zielonka will test MITHRAS 1000 illumination rounds today, Wednesday,

November 18, from 4:00 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. Bright lights will appear in the sky and stay visible for a long time as they drift down slowly on parachutes. The ministry warns that the lights may look like “a slow-moving aircraft, a large drone or an unusual flying object.”

These lights come from planned, authorized military tests. They do not signal a threat to the public, and you do not need to shelter or change your plans.

 

Actions to Take:

  • Stay calm. If you see bright, slow-falling lights during the test window, they most likely come from these tests.

item.title: Medicare Changes Effective November 9, 2026
item.content:encoded:
Medicare Changes Effective November 9, 2026
Informational Notice for Foreign Customers

Important Information:

A new law has changed the eligibility requirements for Medicare. Under this law, an individual may be entitled to or enrolled for Medicare only if they are:

  • A U.S. citizen or national;
  • A lawful permanent resident (green card holder);
  • Lawfully residing in the U.S. in accordance with the Compacts of Free Association (citizens of the Federated States of Micronesia, the Republic of the Marshall Islands, or the Republic of Palau); or
  • A Cuban-Haitian entrant.

For more information please visit: https://www.ssa.gov/benefits/medicare/eligibility/

The law makes no changes to Social Security benefit eligibility or payment rules.

If your Medicare is terminated or denied, you may submit an appeal in writing within 60 days of receiving your decision letter.

item.title: Security Alert – Shooting in Krakow Main Market Square
item.content:encoded:
Security Alert – Shooting in Krakow Main Market Square

Event: Local police confirmed reports of shots fired in Krakow’s Main Market Square. Avoid the area at this time. We will continue to monitor the situation and provide updates.

We encourage U.S. citizens to review our Worldwide Caution. U.S. citizens are strongly encouraged to maintain a high level of vigilance and practice good situational awareness when traveling abroad especially during holiday festivals or public events. In the event of an emergency, call 1-1-2 for Polish Emergency Services.

Actions to Take

  • Avoid crowds and demonstrations.

item.title: Demonstration Alert – Week of Polish Independence Day – November 6, 2026

Demonstration Alert – Week of Polish Independence Day – November 6, 2026

Demonstration Alert – Week of Polish Independence Day – November 6, 2026

Demonstrations as well as numerous celebrations and marches will take place to commemorate Polish Independence Day on November 11. These events include official state ceremonies as well as marches organized by various groups.

Demonstration:

Where: Participants will assemble at Plac Konstutucji and march along the streets: Piękna, Aleje Ujazdowskie, Plac Trzech Krzyży, Nowy Świat, Rondo DeGaulle’a, Nowy Świat and finish at Krakowskie Przedmieście in front of the Presidential Palace.

When: November 8, 2026, Sunday, 15:00 – 18:00

Why: In support of strengthening state security and cooperation with Palantir.

Marches:

First March: Independence March
